visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black NBA-branded baseball cap and a plain black oversized t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor wet market. He has a slight smile and looks towards someone off-camera. Red honeycomb-shaped decorations hang from the ceiling pipes. Behind him are crates of fresh vegetables, including purple-wrapped items and green leafy greens. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the back of the man's t-shirt. The shirt features yellow text that reads 'TAIWANESE LOCAL DISHES PICTORIAL' with various cartoon food illustrations like dumplings, shaved ice, and fried chicken, many wearing sunglasses. (3) The man is seen in a medium close-up, using a wooden toothpick to eat a small piece of food. He chews with a satisfied, thoughtful expression. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional indoor shoot. (4) The man is sitting on a small red plastic stool in the middle of the market aisle. He holds a square slice of white bread up to his face, partially covering the small graphic on the front of his shirt. He looks directly at the camera while taking a bite.
